title: BeatsPost
description: A short text post / annotation on a snapshot. Text is deliberately 'safe and limited': a printable-ASCII allowlist, an explicit length cap, nothing else. Non-ASCII (including homoglyphs, zero-width and bidi-override characters), control characters (including newline and tab) and markup-significant punctuation are rejected, at sign time and again at verify time. The allowlist in x-textPolicy is the single source of truth; the pattern below is generated from it for generic validators.

parent.description: envelope CID of the post being replied to

x-textPolicy.notes: allowedChars is exactly: A-Z a-z 0-9, space, and . , ! ? ' " - _ : ; ( ) + = / @ #. Excluded on purpose: < > & ` \ { } [ ] | ~ ^ $ * % and every non-ASCII code point. Leading/trailing space and runs of 2+ spaces are also rejected.

x-rules: text satisfies x-textPolicy at sign time and at verify time

x-credential.standard: W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0; this schema constrains credentialSubject
x-credential.cid: CIDv1 dag-json sha2-256, base58btc, multibase z, of the whole credential (proof included)
